scripts.dev:backend: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path services/backend/venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1) { . services/backend/venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1; uvicorn app.main:app --reload } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload }"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:extension
scripts.test:backend: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path services/backend/venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1) { . services/backend/venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1; pytest services/backend } else { python -m pytest services/backend }"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:web
